method: For each of the 14,136 frozen FINAL-1.1 process states, maximize strict-scaling TOF over the canonical 0.005-eV E_N grid. At fixed state, metal inventory, reactor volume and vessel cost are monotone in required active metal / bed volume, so the E_N that maximizes TOF is also the cost-minimizing E_N for every lifetime/recovery value. The global lifecycle boundary is then the lower envelope over all states.
interpretation: The direct activity-only target is unreachable. Allowing lifetime and recovery to improve jointly moves the economic target much closer to the strict scaling manifold, but the preregistered lifecycle box (life <= 20 y, recovery <= 0.99) still does not intersect it. The nearest tested corner misses Fe by 0.0708 USD/t NH3 (0.46%). Parity is reached just outside the box, e.g. at 20 y with 99.1186% recovery or at 99% recovery with 22.69 y lifetime.
